anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: At the completion of the ages, to put away sin.
He killed the enmity; preached peace to those far and near.
Redeemed from the authority of darkness; transferred into the kingdom of his light.

pass_a_gloss: which he also did, having come upon a completion of the ages into a setting-aside of the sin through his flesh, having killed the enmity, having come he announced good news to us the ones far and the ones near, having redeemed us from the authority of the darkness and having transferred us in his light.
pass_b_english: which he also did, having come at the completion of the ages for the putting away of sin through his flesh, having killed the enmity. Having come he preached good news to us who were far and to those near, having redeemed us from the authority of the darkness and having transferred us in his light.
source_text: ὅπερ καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων ἐλθὼν εἰς ἀθέτησιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας διὰ τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο ἡμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ τοῖς ἐγγύς, λυτρωσάμενος ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ σκότους καὶ μεταστήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ φωτὶ αὐτοῦ.
